name: Wencan Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wencan Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of automotive aluminum alloy precision castings in China, rest of Asia, Europe, and the Americas. It offers integrated body systems, such as monocoque front end, split front end, integrated side panel, and semi-monocoque rear and rear floor assembly; body structural system, including A pillar, door panel, rear longitudinal beam, front shock absorber, and torque box; battery housing assembly and component, and hybrid battery housing box; and new energy power system comprising three-in-one motor housing, range-extender motor housing, range-extender motor housing end cover, front box, intermediate housing, and …
